svg.title: DressMe A1 Academic Poster
svg.desc: Editable vector design with live text. Uses Calibri, Bodoni MT and Garamond fonts. All mockup data is illustrative.
svg.text: An intelligent fashion ecosystem that transforms your wardrobe into a personalized digital experience using Artificial Intelligence, Computer Vision,
